about_short_description.short_description: Nx assist system development by supporting monorepos and offering robust integrations.

product.name: Nx
product.description: A build system and development toolkit for managing monorepos with support for task running, caching, and dependency graph analysis.

product.name: Nx Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based continuous integration platform optimized for monorepos, offering distributed task execution, remote caching, and CI cost reduction.

product.name: Nx AI
product.description: An AI integration that connects language models to Nx workspaces for architecture-aware code analysis, CI failure diagnosis, and intelligent code generation.

product.name: Nx Plugins
product.description: Extensions for Nx workspaces that provide pre-configured tooling, code generators, and integrations for various technologies and frameworks.

product.name: Nx Console
product.description: An integrated development environment extension that provides a graphical interface for running Nx commands and managing workspace tasks.

product.name: Polygraph
product.description: Polygraph is an Nx service that builds a synthetic monorepo and shared memory layer so AI coding agents can work across multiple repositories as one codebase.
